interactive jobs continue separately. Remove backpressure only after depth
stays below 300 for ten consecutive minutes.

## Summary

Resolved issue #2291 where Auckland customer invoices displayed due dates one day early by replacing datetime.utcnow() with the customer's specific ZoneInfo timezone in billing/due_dates.py. The fix ensures accurate date truncation relative to the customer's [REDACTED] time, verified by passing all 14 tests including a new regression test for Pacific/Auckland.
